summary: Barings BDC, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a new Credit Support Agreement (New CSA) with its adviser Barings LLC upon termination of the prior CSA from 2022. The New CSA provides credit support for two legacy portfolio investments valued at $10.99 million, with the adviser obligated to cover losses exceeding proceeds through April 1, 2032. Settlement occurs via waiver of incentive fees and base management fees over four quarters after the settlement date. This is a contractual arrangement between fund and adviser, not a corporate event. No special-situation category applies.
